info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v5-spec
info.description: The Pet Foster Management API provides access to information regarding available pets for adoption and foster care. Users can retrieve a list of pets that are currently in foster homes, enabling them to explore options for adoption or support. This API is ideal for animal shelters, rescue organizations, and individuals looking to foster pets. It facilitates seamless interaction with the foster pet database, supporting the mission of increasing pet adoption and improving animal welfare.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of pets available for fostering.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about pets that are currently available for fostering. It returns a list of pets along with their descriptions, requirements, and other necessary details.
